app.title: PayHop: payment QR codes and split bills in your browser
app.desc: Make a payment QR code and split a bill on your device. PayHop shows who gets paid and never touches the money.
ft.tagline: Payment QR codes and split bills, made in your browser.
hero.h1: Payment QR codes, made on your device
hero.lede: Type who gets paid and how much. PayHop builds the QR in your browser, shows the name it will pay, and never touches the money. Split a bill and send everyone their share.
hero.proof: No account needed. Nothing you type is uploaded.
home.s1_sub: A wrong payment QR is hard to undo. Every screen puts the receiver's name first.
home.b1_p: Links and bank transfers whose structure is public. Bank-QR schemes such as QRIS and Pix come after we test them on real QR codes.
home.b2_p: Before you can download, you confirm the receiver. Hidden and right-to-left characters in names are stripped, and the name is printed under the QR.
home.b3_p: Amounts are whole minor units, never floats. The odd unit is shared out, and the person who paid absorbs any rounding.
home.b4_p: The QR is drawn on your device and works offline once the page has loaded. Guests leave nothing on our server.
home.b5_p: PayHop does not process money. Saved payment methods will need a HOP ID, be encrypted at rest and can be deleted at any time.
home.b6_p: Each format says whether it has been tried in a real wallet. Until then it says so on the screen, not in a footnote.
home.holds_paypal: A paypal.me link with amount and currency
home.holds_cashapp: A cash.app link with the amount
home.holds_venmo: A venmo.com link with amount and note
home.holds_solana: A solana: address with amount and token
home.holds_upi: A upi://pay request with name and amount
home.holds_epc: A SEPA credit transfer (BCD) with IBAN check
home.later: Waiting for real sample QR codes:
home.s3_sub: One HOP ID signs you in everywhere.
gen.title: Payment QR
gen.sub: Pick a format, fill in who gets paid. The code updates as you type, and nothing leaves this tab.
f.recipient_hint: A Solana address is 32 bytes in base58.
f.label: Label (the name people see)
f.name: Receiver name
f.name_hint: Required. It is shown here and printed on the PNG.
err.receiver_name_required: Add the receiver name. A code without a name is not made.
err.bad_handle: This does not look like a valid handle for this format.
err.bad_iban: The IBAN checksum or length is wrong.
err.bad_address: A Solana address is 32 bytes in base58 (no 0, O, I or l).
err.amount_format: Use digits and one decimal separator, for example 12.50.
err.amount_not_positive: The amount must be more than zero.
err.currency_required: Pick a currency when you set an amount.
err.bad_currency: This is not a currency code.
err.too_long: This text is too long for the format.
err.bad_purpose: A purpose code has four capital letters.
warn.amount_rounded: The amount was rounded to the currency's smallest unit.
warn.no_label: No label: the wallet will show only the address.
warn.non_sepa_characters: Some banks reject characters outside the SEPA set (accents, symbols).
warn.mixed_scripts: The name mixes alphabets, which can be used to imitate another name.
warn.hidden: Hidden or right-to-left characters were removed from {field}.
gen.fix: Fix the highlighted field to see the code.
gen.not_tested: Not tested in a wallet yet
gen.confirm: I checked that this name and account are the ones I want to be paid on.
gen.png_note: The PNG has the name and amount printed under the code, so a shared picture still says who it pays.
gen.png_check: Check the name before you pay
gen.save_consent: I agree that PayHop stores this account number on its server, encrypted, so I can reuse it. It is personal data and I can delete it at any time.
gen.save_hint: Coming later, and it will need a HOP ID. Today nothing you type is saved.
split.title: Split a bill
split.sub: Add who was there, what each item cost and who shared it. Taxes and tips are spread by what each person ordered.
split.round_hint: Everyone except the person who paid is rounded up; the payer takes the difference, so the total never changes.
split.method_hint: Fill in how {payer} wants to be paid. Each person's QR holds their own share.
split.warn_round_over: Rounding would exceed the total, so it was not applied.
split.empty: Add at least one person and one item.
split.one_person: At least one person must stay.
auth.err_expired: The sign-in link expired. Try again.
auth.err_invalid: The sign-in link was not valid.
auth.err_failed: Sign-in did not work. Try again.
dash.sub: Your HOP ID is signed in here. Making a QR and splitting a bill work the same as for guests.
dash.methods_p: Coming later. When it arrives you will choose per method whether to save it, it will be encrypted, and you can delete it at any time.
dash.history_p: Coming later. Today no bill is stored for anyone.
